title: Homelab
description: The homelab at a glance: cluster health and capacity, nodes, TrueNAS, workloads, Flux, ingress and storage.

panels.title: Nodes ready
panels.description: Nodes whose Ready condition is true (of 2).

panels.title: Pods in trouble
panels.description: Pending, Failed or Unknown pods plus containers stuck in CrashLoopBackOff or an image pull error. The Workloads row lists them with the reason.

panels.title: Restarts (24h)
panels.description: Container restarts in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Flux not ready
panels.description: Flux resources (Kustomizations, HelmReleases, sources) whose Ready condition is not True.

panels.title: Alerts firing
panels.description: Firing Prometheus alerts with severity warning or critical. Prometheus UI lists them.

panels.title: Volumes over 80%
panels.description: Mounted claims that are more than 80% full.

panels.title: Next TLS expiry
panels.description: Time until the first cert-manager certificate expires.

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: Per node: the Talos release (OS), Kubernetes and kernel version, whether it is Ready, time since boot, and CPU, memory and /var used now. `t -n <IP> version` shows the same.

targets.expr: max by (node, internal_ip, os_image, kubelet_version, kernel_version) (kube_node_info)

max by (node) (label_replace((time() - node_boot_time_seconds{job="node-exporter"}) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info), "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.+)"))

max by (node) (label_replace(1 - sum by (nodename) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode=~"idle|iowait",job="node-exporter"}[5m]) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info)) / count by (nodename) (max by (nodename, cpu) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle",job="node-exporter"} * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info))), "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.+)"))

max by (node) (label_replace(max by (nodename) (1 - (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter"} / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter"}) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info)), "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.+)"))

max by (node) (label_replace(max by (nodename) (1 - (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/var",job="node-exporter"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/var",job="node-exporter"}) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info)), "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.+)"))

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Used is what the node really does. Reserved is the sum of the running pods' requests, which is what the scheduler counts: at 100% no new pod fits, however idle the node is.

targets.expr: 1 - sum by (nodename) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode=~"idle|iowait",job="node-exporter"}[5m]) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename="homelab"})) / count by (nodename) (max by (nodename, cpu) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle",job="node-exporter"} * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename="homelab"})))

sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Running|Pending"}) == 1)) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu",node="homelab"})

1 - sum by (nodename) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode=~"idle|iowait",job="node-exporter"}[5m]) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename="homelab2"})) / count by (nodename) (max by (nodename, cpu) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle",job="node-exporter"} * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename="homelab2"})))

sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Running|Pending"}) == 1)) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu",node="homelab2"})

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Used is what the node really does. Reserved is the sum of the running pods' requests, which is what the scheduler counts: at 100% no new pod fits, however idle the node is.

targets.expr: max by (nodename) (1 - (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter"} / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter"}) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename="homelab"}))

sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Running|Pending"}) == 1)) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory",node="homelab"})

max by (nodename) (1 - (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter"} / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter"}) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename="homelab2"}))

sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Running|Pending"}) == 1)) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory",node="homelab2"})

panels.title: Disk (/var)
panels.description: Used space on each node's /var, where Talos keeps images, logs and emptyDirs (/ is read-only).

targets.expr: max by (nodename) (1 - (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/var",job="node-exporter"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/var",job="node-exporter"}) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename="homelab"}))

max by (nodename) (1 - (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/var",job="node-exporter"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/var",job="node-exporter"}) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename="homelab2"}))

1 - sum by (nodename) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode=~"idle|iowait",job="node-exporter"}[5m]) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info)) / count by (nodename) (max by (nodename, cpu) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle",job="node-exporter"} * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info)))

max by (nodename) (1 - (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter"} / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter"}) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info))

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: CPU package and NVMe (dashed) temperature.

targets.expr: max by (nodename) (node_thermal_zone_temp{type="x86_pkg_temp",job="node-exporter"} * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info))
max by (nodename) (node_hwmon_temp_celsius{chip=~"nvme.*",sensor="temp1",job="node-exporter"} * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info))

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Wired interface traffic per node; out is drawn below the axis.

targets.expr: sum by (nodename) (rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{device=~"en.*|eth.*",job="node-exporter"}[5m]) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info))
sum by (nodename) (rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{device=~"en.*|eth.*",job="node-exporter"}[5m]) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info))

panels.title: Load (1m) per core
panels.description: 1-minute load average divided by the core count; above 1 means work is queueing.

targets.expr: max by (nodename) (node_load1{job="node-exporter"} * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info)) / count by (nodename) (max by (nodename, cpu) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle",job="node-exporter"} * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info)))

panels.title: NAS
panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape the NAS. node-exporter on the NAS (truenas/apps/node-exporter).

panels.title: Pools
panels.description: Pools whose ZFS state is not online (degraded, faulted, ...). TrueNAS mails its own alerts.

panels.title: pool1 free
panels.description: Space datasets can still use on pool1 (two mirrors), snapshots and the cluster's iSCSI zvols already taken off. Yellow below 1.5 TB, red below 750 GB.

panels.title: Hottest disk
panels.description: Highest SATA disk temperature (drivetemp): the four pool disks and the cache SSD. All are rated to 70 °C; below 45 °C is comfortable.

panels.title: Disk temperature
panels.description: pool1's two mirrors, its SSD read cache (L2ARC) and the NVMe boot disk, named by the SATA port they sit on.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(node_hwmon_temp_celsius{job="truenas",chip=~"target.*|nvme.*",sensor="temp1"}, "disk", "mirror-0 disk 1", "chip", "target2:.*"), "disk", "mirror-0 disk 2", "chip", "target3:.*"), "disk", "mirror-1 disk 1", "chip", "target1:.*"), "disk", "mirror-1 disk 2", "chip", "target4:.*"), "disk", "SSD cache", "chip", "target5:.*"), "disk", "boot NVMe", "chip", "nvme.*")

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: All four cores. Waiting on disk (iowait) is idle time while the disks are busy, e.g. a Cloud Sync run.

panels.title: CPU temperature
panels.description: CPU package temperature (coretemp).

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: 32 GB in total. ZFS keeps its read cache (ARC) in memory and gives it back under pressure.

panels.title: Disk throughput
panels.description: Bytes read and written per disk; write is drawn below the axis. pool1's two mirrors, its SSD read cache (L2ARC) and the NVMe boot disk, named by the SATA port they sit on.

targets.expr: sum by (disk) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(rate(node_disk_read_bytes_total{job="truenas"}[5m]) * on (device) group_left (path) node_disk_info{job="truenas",path!=""}, "disk", "mirror-0 disk 1", "path", ".*-ata-3[.]0"), "disk", "mirror-0 disk 2", "path", ".*-ata-4[.]0"), "disk", "mirror-1 disk 1", "path", ".*-ata-2[.]0"), "disk", "mirror-1 disk 2", "path", ".*-ata-5[.]0"), "disk", "SSD cache", "path", ".*-ata-6[.]0"), "disk", "boot NVMe", "path", ".*-nvme-.*"))

sum by (disk) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total{job="truenas"}[5m]) * on (device) group_left (path) node_disk_info{job="truenas",path!=""}, "disk", "mirror-0 disk 1", "path", ".*-ata-3[.]0"), "disk", "mirror-0 disk 2", "path", ".*-ata-4[.]0"), "disk", "mirror-1 disk 1", "path", ".*-ata-2[.]0"), "disk", "mirror-1 disk 2", "path", ".*-ata-5[.]0"), "disk", "SSD cache", "path", ".*-ata-6[.]0"), "disk", "boot NVMe", "path", ".*-nvme-.*"))

panels.title: Network
panels.description: eno1 traffic: iSCSI and NFS for the cluster, backups, SMB. Out is drawn below the axis.

panels.title: Reads RAM missed: SSD cache vs disks
panels.description: Where pool1 found the reads its RAM cache (ARC) did not have: the SSD read cache (L2ARC) or the four disks. The more comes from the SSD, the fewer slow disk seeks. A scrub reads the disks directly and skips the cache.

panels.title: Cache hit rate
panels.description: Share of lookups each cache answered. RAM sees every read; the SSD only sees what RAM missed, so its rate is lower and swings with the workload. Only frequently used blocks go to the SSD (TrueNAS tunable l2arc_mfuonly=1).

panels.title: SSD cache size
panels.description: Space the read cache uses on the SSD (about 236 GB usable). It fills from RAM over days and TrueNAS keeps it across reboots (persistent L2ARC).

panels.title: Pods in trouble: which and why
panels.description: Every pod the 'Pods in trouble' tile counts: its phase, the container that is waiting and why (CrashLoopBackOff, ImagePullBackOff, Unschedulable, Evicted, ...), and how old the pod is. Empty means nothing is stuck.

targets.expr: ((max by (namespace, pod, phase) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Failed|Unknown"} == 1) * on (namespace, pod) group_right (phase) (max by (namespace, pod, container, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason == 1) or max by (namespace, pod, reason) (label_replace(kube_pod_status_unschedulable == 1, "reason", "Unschedulable", "", "")) or max by (namespace, pod, reason) (kube_pod_status_reason == 1))) or (max by (namespace, pod, phase) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Failed|Unknown"} == 1) unless on (namespace, pod) (max by (namespace, pod, container, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason == 1) or max by (namespace, pod, reason) (label_replace(kube_pod_status_unschedulable == 1, "reason", "Unschedulable", "", "")) or max by (namespace, pod, reason) (kube_pod_status_reason == 1))) or (max by (namespace, pod, container, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{reason=~"CrashLoopBackOff|ImagePullBackOff|ErrImagePull|CreateContainerConfigError|CreateContainerError"} == 1) unless on (namespace, pod) max by (namespace, pod, phase) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Failed|Unknown"} == 1))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (time() - kube_pod_created)

panels.title: Top pods by CPU
panels.description: CPU cores used now (5-minute rate).

panels.title: Top pods by memory
panels.description: Working set memory now.

panels.title: Reserved CPU left idle
panels.description: CPU request minus CPU used: the first candidates for smaller requests.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Running|Pending"}) == 1)) - sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="",image!=""}[5m])))

panels.title: Flux: not ready
panels.description: Flux resources whose Ready condition is not True. Empty means everything reconciled.

panels.title: Ingress requests
panels.description: Requests per second through Traefik, top 8 services.

panels.title: Ingress errors (5xx)
panels.description: Server errors per second through Traefik.

panels.title: Volumes
panels.description: How full each mounted claim is (iSCSI, NFS and local).
